order.caption: Prep: fit the stack compression springs and sleeve O-rings into the head (manual step 1).
Build the stage stack: seal rings (Pos. 45, inner edge down) and retainers into chambers, then impellers, spacers, and bearing rings per the stage diagram, highest stage first.
Strap the stack (strap bolts to 15 Nm), drop the shaft with pin and clamp spacer through it, then the lock washers and lock nut torqued to 22 Nm.
Lower the stack into the sleeve flange; press the sleeve home over it, straps centered between the staybolts.
Lower the pump head assembly over the shaft and seat it on the sleeve; align the vent plug with the flange flat. (Cool-Top variants prep the disk plate and bushings first.)
Fit the support foot, washers, and staybolt nuts — loose for now (torqued at step 31).
Lower the cartridge seal over the shaft and torque to 35 Nm. Do NOT tighten the set screws yet (step 33).
Seat the base O-ring into the cleaned base groove (manual step 27), slide the cartridge into the base, and torque the sleeve flange screws diagonally to 75 Nm; the flange must seat with no gap.
Set the motor on the stool and tighten the motor bolts diagonally (text: 23/40 Nm by bolt size; torque table differs — verify before quoting).
Torque the staybolt nuts diagonally (CR-H 80 / CRN-H 100 Nm), then tighten the slide rail screws.
Tighten the three shaft-seal securing screws to 2.5 Nm (step 33), then fit the shaft pin and coupling halves.

Set the coupling height with the spacer tools; torque the coupling bolts (M6 13 / M8 31 / M10 62 Nm) with an even gap. Install the coupling guards (T20, 2 Nm; the first guard fits earlier, at step 26). Spin the shaft by hand — proceed only if free.

Discharge flange last (steps 41-44): grease the groove, seat the O-ring, position the flange for plug access and torque the allen screws diagonally to 20 Nm with no gaps, then fit the flange ring and retaining ring.
